svg.text: CR2032 • all through-hole • no firmware • hold insulated pickup close to target
L1: 20 turns, Ø6 mm air core
Coil leads ≤10 mm; insulation on tip
A1 / A2 are collector test points
R13 prevents chatter at the threshold
Output LOW when switching is detected
Same net labels join electrically. All ground symbols join B1 −. Values are Ω unless stated. Capacitors C1–C4, C6–C7 are nonpolar.
Build on 2.54 mm perfboard; keep pickup / Q1 away from LED wiring. Use at ≥2.7 V. Prototype design: physical sensitivity needs testing.
